Shared by test/php/td-ssr-dropzone.test.js (PHP output) and src/form/td-dropzone.ssr.engines.browser-test.js (Chromium / Firefox / WebKit, via test/ssr/fixtures/dropzone.html — GENERATED by `node test/ssr/build-dropzone-fixture.mjs`; the PHP test fails when it is stale). `expect`: the state the hydrated element must hold (name, multiple, required, disabled, hint = the visible hint text, '' = hidden).
